primitive_independence: within each cycle all primitive events are mutually independent; cycles are independent; the same two unknown probabilities apply to all cycles
missingness: the deterministic mask schedule was fixed before simulation and is independent of all health states; NA means unobserved
support_semantics: joint two-parameter set whose log-likelihood is within 2 of its maximum, not a calibrated confidence region

one_repair.semantics: clamp c1 healthy and cut its input effects only; heat still acts on c2 and surge still acts on other nodes; do not condition on c1 having been observed healthy

outputs: baseline system risk range over joint support
repaired system risk and absolute benefit ranges over the same support with parameter witnesses
scope: only two unknown probabilities and one fixed repair; no cutset enumeration or repair-combination optimization
